info.name: Docusign Gets task lists for a room.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The globally unique identifier (GUID) for the account.

items.docs:
Returns the task lists associated with a room.

## Permissions

You must either be a member of the room who has been added to one or more tasks, or have one of the following permissions set to **true:** 

- `canAddTasksToAnyTaskLists`
- `canApplyTaskList`
- `canRemoveAnyTaskList`
- `canSubmitTaskList`
- `canReviewTaskList`

**Note:** If a room has multiple tasks lists, you only see the task lists that contain tasks to which you have been added.

info.name: Docusign Applies a task list to a room.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The globally unique identifier (GUID) for the account.

items.docs:
Applies a task list to a room, based on the `taskTemplateId` that you specify in the `taskList` request body.

**Note:** You must first create a task list template in the console. You cannot create a task list template by using the API at this time. To get the `taskListTemplateId`, use the 	TaskListTemplates: GetTaskListTemplates method.

## Permissions

You must have the `canApplyTaskList` permission set to **true.**

info.name: Docusign Deletes a task list from a room.

params.name: taskListId
params.description: The ID of the task list.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The globally unique identifier (GUID) for the account.

items.docs:
Deletes the specified task list from a room. If there are attached documents, they will remain in the associated room.

## Permissions

You must have the `canRemoveAnyTaskList` permission set to **true.**
